comment: gcp-metadata 8.1.4 pins gaxios exactly at 7.1.3, whose nested glob@10.5.0 and minimatch@9.0.9 carry CVE-2026-118773 and CVE-2026-118764. gaxios 7.1.4 is the same major and depends only on extend, https-proxy-agent and node-fetch, so the scoped override drops glob, minimatch and rimraf from the production closure.
